en: Colorized historical postcard showing a large group of Eastern Orthodox clergy in ornate vestments gathered on the steps of a grand church or cathedral. The clergy form two lines on either side of a stairway leading to the entrance, with bishops and patriarchs in the center. Printed French captions appear beneath the image along with a small serial number on the left and a website watermark on the lower right.
